gloss: male and female (of animals or plants)

definitions.gloss: male and female (of animals or plants)
definitions.explanation: The distinction between male and female, especially in animals, birds, insects, or plants.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雄雌|おすめす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見分|みわ}ける→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧。
examples.english: I can tell the sex of this bird.

examples.japanese: ヒヨコ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雄雌|おすめす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判別|はんべつ}→判別：15349_hanbetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to determine the sex of chicks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雄雌|おすめす}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雄蕊|おしべ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{雌蕊|めしべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有無|うむ}→有無：13019_umu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}できる→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: The sex of a flower can be determined by the presence of stamens and pistils.

notes:
Composed of {雄|おす} (male) + {雌|めす} (female) in their native readings. It is the everyday way to talk about telling the sexes of animals or plants apart.

PRONUNCIATION:
The same kanji are occasionally read ゆうし. The Sino-Japanese compound normally runs the other way, {雌雄|しゆう}, which is the scientific term and also appears in the set phrase {雌雄|しゆう}を{決|けっ}する (to settle which side is stronger).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雄雌|おすめす}を{見分|みわ}ける: to tell male from female
- {雄雌|おすめす}を{判別|はんべつ}する: to determine the sex (of an animal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雌雄|しゆう}: male and female — the written, scientific term; also "victory or defeat" in {雌雄|しゆう}を{決|けっ}する
- {雄|おす}: male (animal)
- {雌|めす}: female (animal)
